name: Duet 80
description: The calibrated successor to Twin 77, fitted to a real CS-80's multisamples, with 22 sampled CS-80 patches (1.1: every CS patch refit with its movement: filter swing, tremolo and vibrato as the real one has them).
blurb: Twin 77 calibrated against a real CS-80 (tuning spread, saw shape, filter slope, headroom), plus 22 patches fitted to sampled CS-80 sounds.
